entities.name: Gwendlyn Di Corci
entities.description: A legendary seductress of Urborg, one of the greatest temptresses of Dominarian lore.

entities.name: Ramirez DePietro
entities.description: A pirate spirit who claims Gwendlyn was his undoing.

entities.name: Fabia of the Golden Throat
entities.description: Cast a spell created by Gwendlyn on Sparrow Hawk.

entities.name: Sparrow Hawk
entities.description: A warlord controlled by Towser, targeted by Fabia's charm spell.

entities.name: Towser
entities.description: Held full control of the warlord Sparrow Hawk.

events.summary: Fabia casts a spell created by Gwendlyn on Sparrow Hawk, but it fails because Towser controls him.
events.quote: Fabia of the Golden Throat cast a spell created by Gwendlyn on Sparrow Hawk to charm him, but it failed
